name: @gofastr/geomap-bundle
description: Trusted host-page MapLibre GL + OpenFreeMap vector-tile bundle for the GoFastr geomap plugin. Builds a single IIFE that scans for [data-fui-geomap] mount elements on the host page and renders a MapLibre map into each (free OpenFreeMap vector tiles, no API key). MapLibre's CSS is injected by the bundle at load.
